feature: 5-stage funnel evaluation metrics with Hit@k, MRR, trace extensions, and eval script
problem: V4.2 pipeline has no unified evaluation path. Hit@k/MRR functions don't exist as reusable code. InvestigationTrace lacks funnel fields. No script to run the full V4.2 pipeline end-to-end on eval cases.
proposed_solution: New eval/metrics.py with FunnelMetrics, compute_hit_at_k, compute_mrr, compute_funnel. Extend InvestigationTrace with 4 funnel fields. Add build_v42_trace() factory. New run_scoped_eval.py script for full pipeline eval.
acceptance_criteria: AC1: FunnelMetrics dataclass has recall_100, pre_score_recall_15, triage_recall_7, exam_recall, hit_at_5 (all bool|None), mrr (float|None), hit_rank (int|None), phase2b_triggered (bool)
AC2: compute_hit_at_k returns (True, rank) when GT in top-k suspects, (False, None) otherwise
AC3: compute_mrr returns 1/rank when GT found, 0.0 when not found
AC4: compute_funnel computes all 5 stages from pipeline outputs in one call
AC5: InvestigationTrace has pre_score_recall_15, triage_recall_7, exam_recall, phase2b_triggered fields
AC6: build_v42_trace() wires FunnelMetrics into InvestigationTrace + OutcomeRecord
AC7: Suspect.to_dict() is the adapter for D3/D6 (no separate class needed)
AC8: run_scoped_eval.py runs full V4.2 pipeline per case with 5-stage funnel reporting
edge_cases: EC1: GT not retrievable (recall_100=False) — all downstream metrics are None
EC2: GT in candidates but not in suspects — hit_at_5=False, exam_recall depends on diff calls
EC3: Empty suspects list — hit_at_5=False, mrr=0.0
verification_method: pytest tests/test_funnel_metrics.py — all tests pass; full suite zero regressions
